name: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté finely chopped onion and minced garlic until translucent.
Add the minced beef and brown it, breaking up any lumps.
Stir in canned tomatoes, season with salt, pepper, and basil, then simmer for 20‑30 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
Drain the spaghetti and combine with the Bolognese sauce before serving.

name: Beef Tacos
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat and add a little oil.
Sauté chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the minced beef, chili powder, and cumin; cook until beef is fully browned.
Warm taco shells according to package instructions.
Fill each shell with the seasoned beef, then top with shredded lettuce, grated cheddar, and salsa.

name: Shepherd's Pie
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F).
Boil peeled potatoes until tender, then mash with butter, milk, salt and pepper; set aside.
In a pan, sauté diced onion, carrot, and peas, then add the minced beef and cook through.
Stir in beef broth and simmer until the mixture thickens slightly.
Transfer the beef mixture to a baking dish, spread the mashed potatoes on top, and smooth the surface.
Bake for 25‑30 minutes until the topping is golden brown.

name: Beef Chili
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté chopped onion and minced garlic until fragrant.
Add the minced beef and brown it, breaking up clumps.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, and paprika; cook for 1 minute.
Add canned tomatoes, kidney beans, and a splash of water; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 30‑40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until flavors meld.
Season with salt and pepper to taste before serving.

name: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cook egg noodles according to package directions; drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, melt butter and sauté sliced onion, minced garlic, and sliced mushrooms until softened.
Add the minced beef and cook until browned.
Sprinkle flour over the mixture and stir to coat.
Gradually pour in beef broth, stirring constantly, and bring to a simmer until the sauce thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in sour cream; season with salt and pepper.
Serve the beef stroganoff over the cooked egg noodles.
